policy.note: A provider being usable as a basemap or human-review reference does not imply permission to download/store pixels or run automated ML analysis.

esri_world_imagery_review.note: Existing WHITEBLOCK review conclusions may be retained as metadata. Automated pixel ingestion is disabled until terms for the intended ML workflow are explicitly verified.

licensed_detection_feed.note: The Phase 4 adapter is implemented but remains fail-closed until a licensed imagery/detection source is configured.
